title: Local Telemetry Layer Across Organization Apps
summary: Decision dossier for a local-first organization telemetry layer. It inventories existing Agent Studio and Quality Studio telemetry, defines a content-free event envelope and structured-log seam, compares three no-cloud bus options, recommends a hybrid file buffer plus local push into the existing Agent Message Bus, connects event patterns to the Global Orchestrator Watcher, positions Agent Studio as the CI/CD, telemetry, alarm, and orchestration management hub, and proposes a Quality Studio reliability pilot followed by a bounded product rollout.
